title: finding(components): the `header-bar` root still drops `ariaLabel`, `style`, `id`, `testId` and `data-obj-*` — the registered renderer reads `schema` only, so `BaseSchema`'s declared channels never reach the `header`
body:
Filing-gate category: ② a declared-but-unenforced contract channel, measured. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui#4` execution seat (`session_01BP8CMtACxTdLjqR6rhd33C`) from objectui#10397 (PR objectui#10481, class b). The dev measured it, and the PR's contract review confirmed it by reading. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## The gap

The `header-bar` renderer (`packages/components/src/renderers/navigation/header-bar.tsx`) is registered as a function of `({ schema })` alone. `SchemaRenderer` hands each component `aria-label` (from `ariaLabel`), `data-obj-id` / `data-obj-type`, a conditional `data-testid`, `style` and `id` as props, and the renderer reads none of them. objectui#10397 made the root honour `className`; its root still carries that one attribute only. Measured one key at a time through the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry: the root markup is unchanged for each of `style`, `id`, `ariaLabel`, `testId` and `data-obj-*`.

The contract text these break:
- `BaseSchema.ariaLabel`: "Rendered as aria-label attribute."
- `BaseSchema.style`: "Inline CSS styles as a JavaScript object."

`testId`'s own declaration concedes "A renderer that drops unknown props drops this one too", so `testId` alone is not a breach.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- **The converged route** is objectui#4435's: `toDomProps` plus `style` by name. It would also put `data-obj-type` on every header. Measure what that does to the widget-dom-leak sweep and to any pin on the header's exact attribute list (objectui#10397's control row asserts `['class']`, so the two must move together).
- **The sharpest half** is `ariaLabel`: an accessible name the author declared never reaches the landmark.

Seam: `types:BaseSchema.ariaLabel / BaseSchema.style → renderer:packages/components header-bar (registered with the schema argument only)`

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items. The pattern `header-bar` near `ariaLabel` / `aria-label` / `style` / `testId` / `data-testid` / `data-obj` / `toDomProps` ⇒ 0 hits. The control `toDomProps` ⇒ objectui#8078, so the instrument is lit.

Dedupe words: `header-bar ariaLabel dropped` · `header-bar style ignored` · `header-bar toDomProps` · `header-bar data-testid`
